en: A black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a full-length side profile of an Indigenous person in elaborate traditional attire, including a patterned jacket, wrapped skirt or loincloth with beadwork, leg ornaments, and a long blade or sword at the hip. The subject stands barefoot against a plain backdrop. Text at the bottom identifies the person as coming from Davao. The overall style suggests an ethnographic or colonial-era postcard.
